directories.purpose: Focused OpenCode/LSP checkout recovery, contracts, runner, registries, hooks, and reports.
Existing OpenCode/GNHF product launcher; reference only in this harness lane.

configuration.effectiveLspRule: The launcher preserves an inherited OPENCODE_CONFIG path when present, merges inherited OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT in memory, then forces lsp=true in the highest-precedence inline config without persisting inherited contents.
configuration.modelRule: The requested model is selected per interactive TUI launch with --model and is never persisted as a machine-wide default.

languageFit.note: Useful for repository Python tests when the current OpenCode requirement is satisfied.
Useful for workflow YAML; current stable OpenCode can auto-install when downloads are permitted.
Activates only when the target project satisfies TypeScript requirements; not forced here.
Current OpenCode built-ins do not list PowerShell; use repository PowerShell validators rather than inventing a custom server.

buildTestDeploy.reason: This lane is harness infrastructure plus bounded machine-local setup; no product deployment.

knownTraps: A folder named AgentSwitchBoard is not proof of a Git checkout; use the checkout resolver before setup when git rev-parse fails.
Never convert or delete a non-Git operator folder merely to manufacture repository proof.
Never edit the operator's existing global, project, OPENCODE_CONFIG, or inline OpenCode configuration from this harness.
Never persist a free trial model as a machine-wide default.
Never send confidential, customer, credential, or private machine data to free trial endpoints.
lsp=true is configuration proof, not active LSP runtime proof.
Do not invent a PowerShell LSP.
Fail closed when OpenCode V2 is detected because current V2 LSP configuration has no runtime effect.
Do not run arbitrary global package installers merely to manufacture a harness pass.
Configure artifacts are immutable per run; never reuse an owned configuration directory.
